Operazioni in bassa visibilità

In this glossary, Operazioni in bassa visibilità refers to: Procedures and requirements for aircraft movements at aerodromes when visibility is reduced below specified minima, including LVP (Low Visibility Procedures).

Definition

Procedures and requirements for aircraft movements at aerodromes when visibility is reduced below specified minima, including LVP (Low Visibility Procedures).

Operational example

ATIS: Low-visibility operations are in effect, expect Low Visibility Procedures and increased spacing.
